title: Natural stabilizer-assisted sol–gel synthesis of medium-entropy spinel ferrites: structural and electrochemical insights for supercapacitor applications
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00340G, Paper
Open Access

Y. Ranjith Kumar, Kasarapu Venkataramana, M. Vasundhara
Medium-entropy spinel ferrite (MnCoNiZn)Fe2O4 was synthesized through an eco-friendly albumen-assisted sol-gel route using albumen. The material exhibited a high specific capacitance of 408.18 F g−1 at 4 F g−1 in 2M KOH electrolyte.
